image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Velociraptor from the config library in a mid-air trip on the racetrack, observed from a clear side-profile. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Dark slate-grey pebbled skin, charcoal-grey vertical camouflage stripes, crimson feather crest/mohawk, yellow slit-pupil eyes. ANATOMY ENFORCEMENT: Exactly THREE fingers on each hand with sharp black talons; prominent sickle claw on feet. ACTION: He is caught mid-air, having unexpectedly tripped over a small, unseen obstacle on the track. His body is momentarily suspended in an awkward, uncontrolled fall, beginning to somersault sideways. His long tail is whipping around wildly as he loses balance. One leg is bent upwards, the other thrust out in a desperate attempt to regain footing. HANDS: His three-fingered hands are thrown out in front of him, fingers splayed wide in sudden, involuntary surprise. FACIAL EXPRESSION: Wide-eyed dismay and surprise, with his beak slightly open in a silent gasp. His cunning expression is replaced by a fleeting moment of vulnerability and shock. SETTING: The prehistoric outdoor dirt track, with a heavy horizontal motion blur in the background to show the speed he was traveling at. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with dynamic action and a hint of comedic helplessness. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' clear side-profile, full-body shot to capture the entire arc of his fall and the surprise on his face.
